The Problem

The Cost of Manual Food Management

Hostel students depend on campus dining — but food requests are handled manually, piece by piece. The result: delayed responses, repeated manual work, and poor visibility of unresolved issues.

Manual Triage

  • Every complaint read, sorted, and forwarded by hand
  • Delayed responses and repeated follow-ups with students

Zero Visibility

  • No live view of open or unresolved food issues
  • Recurring problems identified late — or informally

Safety & Waste Risk

  • Hygiene issues can sit unresolved without priority flags
  • No structured reporting on food wastage
